name: How should I prepare my home before the trim installation team arrives?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before the trim installation team arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation day, clear furniture at least three to four feet away from walls and remove fragile wall decor, drapes, and floor coverings in the work area. Plan an accessible outdoor or garage staging spot where carpenters can set up a miter saw and work tables for cutting stock. If you have pets, secure them away from open pathways, and be ready to confirm paint sheen preferences and profile styles during the initial on-site review so materials can be sourced accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from walls, take down hanging decor, secure pets, and clear a garage or patio workspace for the cutting and staging equipment.
